executive_office.name: Executive Office

market_research.description: Scans the market each week and files only the proposals the evidence supports.

opportunity_lab.description: Generates and sizes product opportunities each week.

competitor_intelligence.name: Competitor Intelligence
competitor_intelligence.description: Watches competitors each week and keeps a sourced profile of each.

customer_voice.name: Customer Voice
customer_voice.description: Turns support requests and feedback into customer insight.

product_discovery.name: Product Discovery
product_discovery.description: Validates opportunities and recommends which are worth a product.

product_analysis.name: Product Analysis
product_analysis.description: Writes the product brief, the economics and feasibility, and the risk register.

planning.name: Planning
planning.description: Writes the PRD, the roadmap, the launch outline, and the budget request.

build.name: Build
build.description: Builds and verifies the product through the SDLC workflow, and runs the retrospective.

release_ops.description: Keeps the launch checklist and release notes, and readies each release for the boss's go-live decision.

growth_gtm.name: Growth & GTM

support.name: Support
support.description: Answers customers after launch, escalates bugs, and writes answers back into the knowledge base.

finance_risk.description: Reviews spending proposals and keeps the risk register current.

people_performance.description: Reviews each squad's record against its charter each week, and reports what is late or silent.
